title: The Promise and Peril of Generative AI: Evidence from GPT as Sell-Side Analysts

live_model.evidence: quarters after GPT-4 Turbo's knowledge cutoff date of April 30, 2023 (Section 2.1); 'We use GPT-4 Turbo in our main analysis' (Section 4.5.2)

prompt.location: Internet Appendix Tables IA1-IA2 and IA7 (not part of the paper text)
prompt.note: Three-stage prompt is described in Section 2.2 but the full text is only in the Internet Appendix.

claim.metric: directional accuracy of one-year-ahead GAAP EPS forecast (explicit direction prompt)
claim.location: Section 4.5.3 text (untabulated); 49.3% when direction is inferred from numeric forecasts

data.source: Earnings press releases from EDGAR 8-K Item 2.02 (public); actual EPS and analyst forecasts from Compustat/CRSP/I-B-E-S (licensed)

notes: The stated April 2023 knowledge cutoff matches gpt-4-1106-preview/gpt-4-0125-preview, not gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 (Dec 2023 cutoff), so the runs used a retired preview. Main results are regression coefficients; each call carries a full press release plus 10 financial statements.
